properties.name: shaft
properties.notes: digitised from a written description; not a survey
properties.quote: The barrenness of the tops of the lodes in silver has led to the general policy in exploring new lodes to sink shafts to considerable depths as much as 500 feet before crosscutting from the shafts to the lode.

source.doc: USGS Bulletin 715-K, The Divide Silver District, Nevada (Adolph Knopf, 1921), p. 147

properties.quote: It was then seen that at one place in the outcrop a prospector had sunk a shaft 10 feet deep;

properties.name: shaft
properties.notes: digitised from a written description; not a survey
properties.quote: A rhyolite dike in the Fraction breccia is well shown in an open cut at the end of the dump at the main shaft, and a rhyolite dike has been cut on the 365 and 470 foot levels.

source.doc: USGS Bulletin 715-K, The Divide Silver District, Nevada (Adolph Knopf, 1921), p. 147

properties.name: crosscut
properties.notes: digitised from a written description; not a survey
properties.quote: The main crosscut on the 265-foot level after cutting through the silver lode was continued southwestward, penetrating the rhyolite stock of Gold Mountain, and at 450 feet from the silver lode it cut a narrow gold vein, probably the downward extension of the gold vein formerly worked higher on the mountain.

source.doc: USGS Bulletin 715-K, The Divide Silver District, Nevada (Adolph Knopf, 1921), p. 147
